## Highlights since 0.17.0

- **Plugin market.** Settings › Plugins now has Installed and Browse. Browse lists plugins from the signed Lattice plugin list, with search and sorting. A plugin's details show what it can do before you install it, then Install and turn on or Install only. When an update asks for more than you allowed, Lattice lists only what is new and asks first; Update all applies the updates that ask for nothing new. If a plugin is withdrawn, Lattice turns it off and says why.
- **User guide.** Help › User Guide opens a short guide to Lattice in English or Chinese, matching the interface language.
- **Agent on Synara 1.6.2.** The Agent asks before resuming a long-idle Claude session, offers guided sign-in in the model picker, can continue a chat on another account or resume an interrupted task, and lets you copy tables from a chat.
- **The Agent uses less memory.** The Agent's background service now uses about a third less memory while idle, around 185 MB instead of 300 MB.

## Notable fixes

- The Agent can create boards again. A board it asks for as `.tldr` is created as `.excalidraw`, and a request Lattice refuses now fails at once instead of timing out.
- macOS no longer autocorrects what you type in find and replace fields, so a search with Match case on finds what you typed instead of a capitalized word.
- Exporting a board as an image now says where the file was saved.
- A board's search and hints are in Chinese when Lattice is.
